description: Hoffer eta (ssl_config.method_params.regularizer_target_ratio, the target ratio of the Hoffer gradient to the supervised gradient at the calibration probes), one at a time around the tuned configuration of whichever Hoffer study is replayed (any loss, Cars196 k=16 or In-Shop k=2); every other parameter keeps its tuned value. Closes the status-table row 'LRML, Hoffer: Staerke eta ... Hoffer: nicht variiert'. Same grid as the LRML eta sweep (configs/ablations/phase2/lrml_mult/*_ablations/lrml.json), which contains the SLADE grid (configs/ablations/phase2/sweeps/slade.json); Phase 1 searched [0.5, 1.5]. Unlike LRML (uncapped), the step-wise cap regularizer_max_ratio keeps the study's value 3, as in Phase 1 and in the SLADE sweep. eta is calibrated on the studies' max_mean gradient statistic while the cap bounds the Euclidean ratio, so the cap can bind below eta = 3 (train/regularizer_max_ratio/*uncapped_ratio records when it does). Seed 2, 1000 epochs as a ceiling, patience 20.
name: hoffer_eta_sweep
